purpose: Measure a constructive lower bound on avoidable missed point visits caused by the original assign-once rule. Preserve all original visit maps, task definitions, recorded paths and physical ledgers. No optimality or empirical authority claim.
parents: All eight network_duty_visits_20261112 scenarios, all actors, every bin. Same target requests, foot-only recorded round trips, supported staff and already reserved patrol slice. Require current parent physical review and exact source identities. No new data or target selection.
algorithm: Keep every originally completed visit and its provider immutable. Begin with parent unused patrol hours. For each originally unmet requested actor/target, retain active same-actor providers with sufficient supported crew and a valid parent walking route. Order pending tasks by their cheapest eligible crew-hour cost, then actor index, then target index. For each task once, choose the cheapest provider whose CURRENT remaining patrol budget can afford the whole visit, provider index tie; complete and debit once. Do not relocate original visits, borrow collection/services/unused gross hours, split tasks, or cross provider/actor/bin budgets.
partition: Original route-unreachable and initially-unaffordable-crew partitions cannot improve when only remaining budgets are spent. Additional completions must be a subset of original capacity_unmet. Retain original service plus added service, reduce capacity_unmet only. Report additions by case/actor/bin, crew-hours used, all remaining budget and original-vs-extended provider assignments.
controls: Manufactured spare-provider recovery, same-actor isolation, original completion preservation, integer task/crew gates, deterministic ties and zero spare budget before production outputs. No-addition with zero spare hours. All accepted original and added tasks charged to recorded provider-specific routes.
review: Independent scalar rerun and path/provider/cost checks; all original completed tasks and providers unchanged; no duplicate actor/target/bin; added subset of old capacity_unmet; all monthly reserved and full-provider ledgers; source hashes; byte-exact fresh fields/results. Findings are a feasible improvement lower bound, not a global optimum or proof remaining deficits are unavoidable.
publication: Publish the eight-case diagnostic, chart and downloads in the normal research evidence atlas; keep the original eight point maps unchanged. If improvements are material, declare any replacement map family separately before building it. Review entire release1-4/S1-S5 programme, push checkpoint and continue. Target-grid sensitivity, individual rosters/daily provisioning, empirical sizes/roles/occupation/prospective transfer and mobile/unaffiliated/nonstate resource integration remain open.
